_comment: Every golden file in this directory, and what it locks.
tests/test_golden.py reads this manifest: an entry without a producer
fails the suite, and a file the manifest does not name is not run.
See README.md for the bar for adding one.

goldens.locks: the /help reply — the top-traffic turn, and the list of commands the user can actually invoke
the facts the agent is grounded in (sysinfo, cwd, project files) and the order they appear in, so a turn cannot quietly stop being told what machine it is on
the two refusals a user sees: the hard refusal for a destructive command, and the sandbox denial for a path outside the roots
the text-JSON tool fallback: markup the agent cannot parse is stripped from the answer and reported, never posted as the answer (#367, #368)
the review prompt — the rules the review engine sends, and the fencing of the diff as untrusted data
